# Avax Staking

> Avax Staking earns AVAX rewards by delegating tokens to an Avalanche validator. The page includes an interactive calculator for staking income after validator reward fees.

## Pages
- [Avax Staking](https://insert_url/): Rewards calculator, staking options, fees, payout timing, security, and FAQ.
- [Dashboard](https://insert_url/dashboard/): Staking dashboard destination.

## Calculator
Inputs: AVAX amount, gross APR, staking term in days, and validator reward fee.
Net reward = amount x (APR / 100) x (days / 365) x (1 - fee / 100).
Annualized rewards = amount x (APR / 100) x (1 - fee / 100).
Default inputs: 1,000 AVAX, 6.50% gross APR, 365 days, and a 2% validator fee.
Default output: 65 AVAX gross rewards, 1.30 AVAX validator fee, 63.70 AVAX net rewards, and 1,063.70 AVAX total at maturity.
Network transaction costs are paid separately. Calculations use simple interest. Native staking rewards are paid at term end, subject to validator reward eligibility.

## Native staking parameters
- Network: Avalanche P-Chain.
- Delegation: minimum 25 AVAX, term of 14 days to one year.
- Validation: minimum 2,000 AVAX, term of 48 hours to one year.
- Validator reward fee: minimum 2% of earned rewards.
- Staked tokens remain locked until the confirmed end date.
- Reward uptime threshold: 90% for validations beginning from Helicon activation on September 22, 2026; 80% for earlier validations.
- Primary Network staking has no stake slashing. Missing the uptime threshold can result in zero rewards.

## Calculation example
At 6.50% gross APR and a 2% validator reward fee, 100 AVAX earns 6.37 AVAX over 365 days. Changing the term or rate changes the result. Native rewards can be restaked after payout.
